title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 27: David among the Philistines, Ziklag and his raids while serving Achish.

questions.text: Where did David decide it was best to escape?
questions.explanation: David said in his heart that there was nothing better for him than to escape into the land of the Philistines.

answers.text: Into the land of the Philistines

questions.text: Achish, king of Gath, was the son of whom?
questions.explanation: David passed over with his men to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

questions.text: How many men passed over with David to Achish?
questions.explanation: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish.

questions.text: Which two wives lived with David at Gath?
questions.explanation: David lived at Gath with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess.

questions.text: What did Saul do when he was told that David had fled to Gath?
questions.explanation: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, and he sought no more again for him.

answers.text: He sought no more for him

questions.text: Which city did Achish give to David?
questions.explanation: Achish gave David Ziklag that day.

questions.text: How long did David live in the country of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: David lived in the country of the Philistines a full year and four months.

answers.text: A full year and four months

questions.text: Which peoples did David and his men raid?
questions.explanation: David and his men raided the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites.

answers.text: The Moabites, the Ammonites and the Edomites
The Jebusites, the Hivites and the Perizzites
The men of Ekron, Ashdod and Gaza
The Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites

questions.text: Why did David leave no man or woman alive on his raids?
questions.explanation: David saved no one alive, lest they should tell about him, saying, "David did this."

answers.text: So that Saul would fear him
So they could not tell what David did
Because there was no food for captives

questions.text: What did Achish believe about David?
questions.explanation: Achish believed David, saying, "He will be my servant forever."

answers.text: David would be his servant forever
David would become king of Gath
